newsitem.title: USA: Med-Design gets patent rights for syringe.
newsitem.headline: Med-Design gets patent rights for syringe.

text.p: Med-Design Corp said Friday that it has acquired patent rights for a syringe from an inventor, John Kulli, for $75,000 and 75,000 warrants on its common stock.
Med-Design said the patent will significantly enhance user appeal, measurably reduce manufacturing cost, and present significant barriers to competition for its Safety Retractable Syringes.

"As a result of acquiring these patents, the company can now design a safety retractable syringe with virtually no change in user technique, as compared to the standard non-safety syringes prevalent in the market today," said James Donegan, chairman and chief executive officer of Med-Design in a press release.
